raw_text: Work then turned to the "research facility," the instrument's web research and provider layer. After fixing a web research bug, the session built a provider probe tool. It snapshots the status of available models from each provider into a committed providers file, scrubs API keys from the output, and flags any model missing since the previous run as removed. The purpose is to give the project a durable, diffable record of provider availability, so that silent model deprecations or removals are caught rather than discovered through failures.
